purpose: Per-run configuration schema for frequency-domain Reference Offset pair construction, complex vector registration, modal analysis, and conditional depth focus.
epistemic_status: Registration vectors and depth-focus scores are image-processing observables and conditional model fits. They do not by themselves establish physical motion, void identity, penetration, or absolute depth.

input_identity.coordinate_convention: Record selected points with explicit row and column names.

edge_overlap_rule.applies_to: Successive Offset-edge spans in ordered K-pair placement.
edge_overlap_rule.validation: For every adjacent pair, realized_overlap_hz <= 0.05 * b_shift_hz after discrete-bin rounding.

example_only.interpretation: An Offset edge spanning 1000 to 1404 Hz may share at most 20.2 Hz with the next ordered Offset-edge span.

registration.pairing_rule: Register only matched R_k and O_k for the same k. No inter-k stack alignment or daisy-chain registration.

modal_analysis.fit_form: Two-component center plus cosine and sine terms in ordered pair index.
modal_analysis.notes: Modal order is an ordered-pair harmonic index, not automatically a physical vibration frequency.

depth_focus.steering_basis: [cos(Kz,k*z), sin(Kz,k*z)] applied to both measured vector components
depth_focus.depth_statement: The z axis is nominal model depth. A calibration anchor is not independent absolute-depth validation.

prohibited_inference: Do not treat a spatial patch as allocation to a particular spectral-edge segment.
Do not treat repeated overlapping windows or adjacent spatial samples as independent detections.
Do not count periodic steering copies or opposite-sign equivalent branches as separate depths.
Do not reuse geometry or parameter values from another acquisition without declaring and validating them anew.
